title: Common affine residue model bridge for derived fibre naturality
statement: In the geometric setup of new-picard-derived-fibre-naturality, choose a common affine neighbourhood, strictly perfect source and target residue models, their residue-to-derived-fibre and residue-to-structure-sheaf additive comparisons, and chain representatives of the canonical coefficient maps. These choices satisfy both affine residue naturality and the geometric structure-sheaf pullback equation simultaneously for every index, including the empty family.
